name: Cappuccino
description: Espresso with steamed milk and a deep cap of foam.

tcm.note: Coffee over milk; the coffee dominates.

ayurveda.note: Ushna; milk's shita does not offset it.

histamine.note: Read as coffee, with milk stacked on top.

stimulant.note: Coffee's profile with milk, which slows the stomach a little and blunts the onset.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
